entries.title: The message box no longer covers the side panels at larger sizes
entries.body: At 125% or 150% Size, the message box now sits just above the collapsed Activity and Tasks panels instead of over them. While a card is open, those collapsed panels are hidden so the card keeps its room, and they come back when you close the last card.

picture.alt: At 150% the message box sits just above the collapsed Activity and Tasks panels at the bottom of the window
